title: E-MTR-0007: the covalent bond with stand-ins: one stand-in electron (the charged fear walk) shared by two fixed...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0007 in the quantum arena: the covalent bond with stand-ins: one stand-in electron (the charged fear walk) shared by two fixed stand-in nuclei in the husk lattice Coulomb potential binds and its antibonding state does not, but at a0 = 4 husk spacings the bond is 21 percent short and 26 percent deep of the continuum H2+ values 1.997 a0 and 0.2053 Ry from the husk lattice core, while a reported follow-up at a0 = 8 reads 1.972 a0 and 0.2027 Ry, within 1.2 percent.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
